_label: SECTION 1 BATCH 1 — universal guiding-planet application claims; development only; practitioner review required
scope: The seven classical rulers when functioning as the ruler of the Ascendant. These claims describe only the planet's licensed guiding emphasis; Ascendant-sign and Ascendant-lord-house records must supply the personal expression and life arena.
writerRule: Only applicationClaims may reach the customer-writing model. A guiding-planet claim may not be expanded into personality, events, status, relationships, health, vocation or outcomes without separately admitted sign and house claims.

applicationClaims.allowedMeaning: With the Sun ruling the Ascendant, the chart's guiding emphasis may return repeatedly to the person's animating sense of self: what feels internally vital, central and genuinely their own.
Direction may feel more coherent when an important choice reflects that internal center rather than being shaped entirely by other people's expectations.
A strong investment in one established self-definition may create tension when growth requires the person to understand themselves differently.

prohibitedExtensions: automatic confidence, leadership, authority, visibility or success
father or government prediction
claim that the Sun alone determines purpose or vocation
ego, narcissism or identity diagnosis

applicationClaims.allowedMeaning: With the Moon ruling the Ascendant, the mind and the person's changing internal response may play an especially central role in how direction is recognized.
Important choices may become clearer when the person notices their internal response without assuming that the first feeling must determine the final direction.
A temporary state of mind may sometimes be mistaken for a permanent truth about the self or the direction life should take.

compositionRequirements: When the Ascendant lord is the Moon, Section 1 may use only these guiding-direction claims. It must not repeat the Moon's house, sign, nakshatra, pada or emotional interpretation owned by Section 2.
prohibitedExtensions: duplication of any Section 2 Moon interpretation
automatic sensitivity, nurturance, intuition, attachment or domesticity
mood-disorder or instability diagnosis
claim that every passing feeling supplies reliable direction

applicationClaims.allowedMeaning: With Mars ruling the Ascendant, the chart's guiding emphasis may involve learning where and how to direct personal force.
Direction may become clearer when energy is given a defined purpose rather than being spent against every source of resistance.
Force may become counterproductive when immediate effort is used where timing, information or a different method is still needed.

prohibitedExtensions: automatic courage, initiative, anger, aggression, conflict or competition
violence, accident, injury or danger prediction
military, athletic, mechanical or leadership destiny
claim that force is always the correct response

applicationClaims.allowedMeaning: With Mercury ruling the Ascendant, speech and the act of giving something clear expression may become recurring channels through which direction is developed.
An important choice may become more workable when the person can name it precisely, discuss it or put its meaning into words.
Language may create the appearance of clarity before the underlying choice has actually become settled.

prohibitedExtensions: guaranteed intelligence, analysis, adaptability, wit or communication skill
commerce, writing, teaching or technology profession prediction
nervous-system or attention diagnosis
claim that verbal explanation alone proves understanding

applicationClaims.allowedMeaning: With Jupiter ruling the Ascendant, knowledge and the kind of understanding that contributes to happiness may become recurring guides in the person's direction.
A path may feel more coherent when it continues to enlarge understanding rather than asking the person to stop learning in order to preserve certainty.
The pursuit of a larger explanation may become ungrounded when accumulating knowledge replaces making a necessary choice.

prohibitedExtensions: automatic wisdom, faith, teaching ability, expansion, luck or benefic protection
religious, academic, legal or advisory profession prediction
wealth, status or success prediction
claim that more knowledge always produces the correct decision

applicationClaims.allowedMeaning: With Venus ruling the Ascendant, love and desire may become important guides in recognizing what the person is genuinely drawn to sustain or pursue.
Direction may feel more personally coherent when a choice acknowledges what matters to the person rather than treating desire as irrelevant information.
Desire may become an incomplete guide when immediate attraction is treated as sufficient evidence that a direction can be sustained.

prohibitedExtensions: automatic beauty, charm, harmony, artistry, pleasure or relationship skill
sexuality, fertility, marriage or partner prediction
luxury, wealth, appearance or artistic profession prediction
claim that attraction or desire alone establishes compatibility or direction

applicationClaims.allowedMeaning: With Saturn ruling the Ascendant, the person's direction may be shaped in part by how they understand and respond to experiences of sorrow or heaviness.
A path may become clearer when difficulty is acknowledged honestly without being treated as the whole meaning of the person's life.
A difficult period may narrow the sense of possibility when present heaviness is mistaken for a permanent description of what the future can hold.

compositionRequirements: Every use of APP-S1-GUIDE-SATURN-SORROW-AS-REALITY must be accompanied by APP-S1-GUIDE-SATURN-HONEST-LIMITS in the same paragraph or the immediately following paragraph.
prohibitedExtensions: automatic discipline, delay, endurance, responsibility, fear, limitation or maturity
suffering as necessary, deserved, spiritually superior or permanently defining
depression, grief disorder or other medical diagnosis
poverty, loneliness, punishment, failure or shortened-life prediction

batchAcceptanceRequirements: Exactly seven records and twenty-one claims must load dynamically through the Section 1 overlay namespace.
Every claim must carry one or more evidenceRecordIds through its parent record and retain development-only status.
No claim may expand beyond the explicit graha-core evidence ceiling without being labeled editorial synthesis draft.
The Moon guiding-planet record must not duplicate Section 2's Moon house, sign, nakshatra or pada meanings.
Mars and Saturn must remain severely limited and their prohibited extensions must be machine-enforced.
Production must admit zero claims from every record.
Section 2 files and all thirteen Section 2 regressions must remain unchanged.
A Section 1 writer must remain fail-closed until an Ascendant-sign claim and an Ascendant-lord-house claim are also admitted for the same chart.
